273a_wrong_arch.reason_invalid: Uploaded runner binary was Linux ARM on an x86_64 runner pool, so every endpoint failed with Exec format error before load.

attempts.reason: The run was clean and converged, but measured delivery fell below item270 and the same three low-outlier endpoints were still pinned to the contaminated runner root@203.0.113.11.

runner_observations: The three weakest endpoints exactly matched the three endpoints assigned to root@203.0.113.11, reproducing the item270 mapping.
Runner profile snapshots repeatedly showed root@203.0.113.11 carrying kube-apiserver, etcd, kube-controller-manager, and kubelet with load averages in the ~7-10 range during and after the run.
The other three runners were also not pristine, but they did not produce the same extreme endpoint collapse as root@203.0.113.11.
conclusion: 273b proves current main still produces a clean green 40k live run with payload caching and parallel writer provisioning, but the run is under-driven and should not replace item270's 34,202.8 committed TPS as the best green performance reference. The next benchmark should replace or isolate root@203.0.113.11 before spending another 40k or 60k rung.
